caption: The drawing features two representations of the same object, which appears to be a candlestick. The larger, central depiction is rendered in color, showing a metallic item with a polished brass or gold appearance, displaying highlights and shaded areas to indicate its three-dimensional form. The base is round and wide, narrowing upward through a series of curves and bulges to a rounded, knob-like top. To the upper left of the colored object, there is a smaller, outlined version of the same object done in black and white, presenting only the contour with no shading or color. Below the outline, a linear scale marked in inches (0 through 3) is included for reference. The drawing is set against a beige background with a thin rectangular border around the objects. In the lower right corner, the name “PHILIP JOHNSON” is printed in capital letters.
title: Candlestick
